label: early-sequence steps 2-4 after an f among the first three tokens
explanation: Fires during the original (input) phase at steps t=2..4 (occasionally 5-6 and the delimiter) when the letter f appeared among the first three original tokens, strictly after that f (f at position 2 only counts from t=3). Strongest when the sequence starts with f, especially f f f prefixes, where activation peaks (~1.0 of max) at the step right after the f run and decays over the next 2-3 steps; prev2_tok=f has 15.8x lift and first_tok=f 12x. Weaker (~0.1-0.4) when the f is at position 1-2 or followed by other tokens. Never fires at t=0-1, in the copy phase, or when no early f is present (except rare tiny activations). Dev F1 ~0.80, mass recall 0.94; misses are mostly tail activations at t=5-6 and the delimiter, false positives are low-activation early-f contexts where it stays silent.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig1=f (+10.50), orig0=f (+8.41), t=3 (+5.89), orig2=f (+5.57), prev3_tok=f (+4.90), prev2_tok=f (+4.64). Lower it: prev2_tok=- (-13.42), phase=2 (-11.53), t=7 (-7.74), orig_idx=-1 (-7.52).
